name: GIF loop
summary: A short clip stored as a GIF that repeats without end, in 256 colours and a small frame.
how: Cut the clip to 1 to 4 seconds and join the last frame to the first.
Export at 10 to 15 fps in 256 colours or fewer.
Keep the frame at 480px wide or less.

origin.note: CompuServe releases the GIF format with support for several frames in one file.

adoptions.via: Tumblr users and later Giphy cut film and TV clips into short loops and send them as replies.
Net artists run glitch effects inside short loops of 20 to 40 frames.
